text: dsh-task-feedback 是面向 DSH Web 与 Desktop 客户端的会话状态反馈插件。浏览器端读取当前会话、子代理活动和待处理交互，在标签页隐藏时用彩色 favicon 提示运行中、完成或等待用户处理的状态；状态变化时还可播放本地合成提示音。设置面板可调整图标形状、提示音及播放范围，适合希望离开页面时仍能感知任务进展的用户。

dsh-task-feedback adds session status feedback to DSH. When the tab is hidden, it updates the favicon to show activity, completion, or a need for input. It can play synthesized sounds on state changes. The Feedback settings panel controls icon shape, sound choices, and playback scope.
切到别的标签页后，我想知道 DSH 任务有没有完成。
能不能在会话需要我确认或回答时提醒我？
I want an audible alert when my DSH session finishes or needs input.
dsh-task-feedback 的功能「标签页状态指示」：当 DSH 会话页处于后台时，根据当前会话和待处理交互更新 favicon 颜色，提示任务进行中、已完成或需要用户处理；页面重新显示时恢复原图标。
dsh-task-feedback 的功能「状态变化提示音」：会话状态转为等待处理或完成时，按设置选择的提示音播放；用户可设定仅页面失焦时播放或始终播放，并在 Feedback 设置中选择音效。

为 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 打造的会话状态反馈插件。基于真实使用痛点而做：

> 切到其他标签页或离开电脑时，无法实时感知到 Agent 是否已完成回复，或是否需要人工介入。
dsh-task-feedback README · 安装：```sh
dsh-task-feedback README · 浏览器访问的 Web profile：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-task-feedback
section: 浏览器访问的 Web profile

text:
dsh-task-feedback README · Desktop 客户端 profile：dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-task-feedback
```

dsh-task-feedback README · 版本对照：DSH 的客户端 API 在 `rc.x` → `alpha.x` 之间**前向不兼容**：装错版本不会优雅降级，而是在运行时直接报错（常见症状 `TypeError: useConversation is not a function`）。请按你的 DSH 版本选择插件版本：

| 你的 DSH | 建议安装 |
|---|---|
| `0.2.x`（已在 `v0.2.1-alpha.2` 上实测） | `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-task-feedback`（最新，当前 `0.2.1`） |
| `0.1.2-alpha.1` ~ `0.1.x` | `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-task-feedback@0.1.0` |
dsh-task-feedback README · 版本对照：> 主视图会话与待介入状态的读取都做了双代次兼容，`0.2.x` 在旧版 DSH 上通常也能运行；但上表中只有 `0.2.x` × `v0.2.1-alpha.2` 这一组经过本版本实测（`0.2.1` 相对 `0.2.0` 仅元数据变更，运行时代码逐字节一致）。
dsh-task-feedback README · Favicon 实时回显会话状态：切走标签页时，把 DSH 的 Favicon 换成状态指示图标（默认小圆点，可在设置中改为圆形或圆角矩形），并根据会话状态实时变色： 1. **绿色**：当前任务已完成 2. **蓝色**：当前任务进行中或子代理正在运行 3. **橙色**：需要人工介入（等待审批、计划确认或回答问题等） 设计巧思：
section: Favicon 实时回显会话状态

text:
dsh-task-feedback README · Favicon 实时回显会话状态：1. 在切走标签页时，才会根据状态更改 Favicon（原生 [Page Visibility API](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Page_Visibility_API) 实现）
2. 若会话本身已经处于空闲/完成状态，Favicon 仍然显示默认的小鲸鱼（最低打扰设计）
3. 支持配置多种形状：`小圆点` | `圆形` | `圆角矩形`
4. **形状设置仅在 Web 模式提供**：Desktop 客户端窗口没有浏览器标签栏，Favicon 不可见，因此设置中的「图标样式」分组会在 Desktop 下自动隐藏
section: Favicon 实时回显会话状态

text: dsh-task-feedback README · 音效提示： 人工精选了 12 个合成音效，可以为「任务已完成」和「需要你介入」分别选择不同的音效，并控制播放时机： 1. `全部`：无论页面是否失焦，只要当前会话已完成或需要人工介入，就播放音频提示； 2. `仅失焦时`：仅在页面失焦时播放音频——切走标签页、最小化、关闭显示器（原生 [Page Visibility API](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Page_Visibility_API)），或切到其他应用/窗口导致窗口失焦（`window` 的 `blur` 事件）

dsh-task-feedback README · 音效提示：**技术亮点** - 所有可选音效均由 [Web Audio API](https://github.com/m1ckc3s/procedural-sounds) 合成，零外部依赖。鼠标悬停即可试听。

所有设置项（Favicon 形状、音效作用域、音效选择）均在 **设置 → 反馈** 中配置，持久化在 localStorage 中。

dsh-task-feedback README · 其他说明：- **从 DSH v0.1.2-alpha.1 开始适配，已在 DSH v0.2.1-alpha.2 上验证**（主视图会话与待介入状态均为双代次兼容读取）
- **双模式适配** — 已在浏览器（Web）与 Desktop 客户端两种模式下验证；Favicon 相关的可视化仅在 Web 模式下可见
- **纯前端** — 无自定义协议、无 host 命令、无 LLM 调用、不进会话日志
- **稳定钩子** - 接入 DSH 的 sessions 与 uiSession 标准服务获取任务的运行状态、子代理活动和待介入事件
- **后续计划** - 支持用户上传自定义音效、支持系统级通知
- **注意事项** - 暂不支持 `/goal` 模式

[中文](README.md) | English

A session status feedback plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). Built from a real pain point:

> When you switch to another tab or step away from your computer, you have no way of knowing whether the agent has finished its response or needs your input.
dsh-task-feedback README · Install：```sh
dsh-task-feedback README · Browser-served Web profile：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-task-feedback

dsh-task-feedback README · Desktop app profile：dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-task-feedback
```

dsh-task-feedback README · Version matrix：The DSH client API is **not forward-compatible** across `rc.x` → `alpha.x`: a wrong pick does not degrade gracefully, it crashes at runtime (common symptom: `TypeError: useConversation is not a function`). Pick the plugin version that matches your DSH:

dsh-task-feedback README · Version matrix：| Your DSH | Install |
|---|---|
| `0.2.x` (verified on `v0.2.1-alpha.2`) | `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-task-feedback` (latest, currently `0.2.1`) |
| `0.1.2-alpha.1` – `0.1.x` | `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-task-feedback@0.1.0` |

dsh-task-feedback README · Version matrix：> The main-view session and pending-interaction reads are dual-generation compatible, so `0.2.x` usually runs on older DSH as well; only the `0.2.x` × `v0.2.1-alpha.2` pairing above has been verified for this release (`0.2.1` differs from `0.2.0` in metadata only — the runtime code is byte-identical).

dsh-task-feedback README · Favicon indicator：When you switch away from the tab, the DSH favicon turns into a coloured dot that reflects the current session state in real time: 1. **Green** — the current task has completed. 2. **Blue** — the current task is in progress or a subagent is running. 3. **Amber** — needs your input (approval, plan confirmation, answering a question, etc.). Design decisions:

dsh-task-feedback README · Favicon indicator：1. The favicon only changes when the tab is hidden (powered by the native [Page Visibility API](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Page_Visibility_API)).
2. If the session was already idle or completed, the favicon stays as the default whale (minimum distraction).
3. Configurable shapes: `Small dot` | `Circle` | `Rounded rectangle`.
4. **The shape setting is Web-only** — a Desktop shell window has no browser tab strip, so the favicon is never visible there and the "Favicon shape" group is hidden in Settings.
dsh-task-feedback README · Sound notifications： 12 hand-picked synthesised sounds. Choose different sounds for "task done" and "needs your input", and control when they play:

dsh-task-feedback README · Sound notifications：1. `Always` — play sound notifications regardless of tab visibility, whenever the session completes or needs your input.
2. `Only when unfocused` — only play while the page is away from you: the tab is hidden (switched away, minimised, display off — native [Page Visibility API](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Page_Visibility_API)) or the window lost focus because you switched to another application (the `window` `blur` event).

dsh-task-feedback README · Sound notifications：**Tech highlight** — all sounds are synthesised in real time via the [Web Audio API](https://github.com/m1ckc3s/procedural-sounds) with zero external dependencies. Hover over any sound option in the settings to preview it.

All settings (favicon shape, sound scope, sound selection) are configured in **Settings → Feedback** and persisted to localStorage.

dsh-task-feedback README · Notes：- **Tested from DSH v0.1.2-alpha.1, verified on DSH v0.2.1-alpha.2** (main-view session and pending-interaction reads stay generation-tolerant)
- **Dual-mode** — verified under both the browser (Web) profile and the Desktop client; everything favicon-related is only visible in Web mode.
- **Frontend only** — no custom protocols, no host commands, no LLM calls, no session-log entries.
- **Stable hooks** — reads session state, subagent activity, and pending interactions through DSH's standard `sessions` and `uiSession` services.
- **Roadmap** — custom sound uploads, system-level notifications.
- **Limitations** — `/goal` mode is not yet supported.

4. **形状设置仅在 Web 模式提供**：Desktop 客户端窗口没有浏览器标签栏，Favicon 不可见，因此设置中的「图标样式」分组会在 Desktop 下自动隐藏
section: Favicon 实时回显会话状态

text: dsh-task-feedback README · 音效提示： 人工精选了 12 个合成音效，可以为「任务已完成」和「需要你介入」分别选择不同的音效，并控制播放时机： 1. `全部`：无论页面是否失焦，只要当前会话已完成或需要人工介入，就播放音频提示； 2. `仅失焦时`：仅在页面失焦时播放音频——切走标签页、最小化、关闭显示器（原生 [Page Visibility API](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Page_Visibility_API)），或切到其他应用/窗口导致窗口失焦（`window` 的 `blur` 事件）

dsh-task-feedback README · 音效提示：**技术亮点** - 所有可选音效均由 [Web Audio API](https://github.com/m1ckc3s/procedural-sounds) 合成，零外部依赖。鼠标悬停即可试听。

所有设置项（Favicon 形状、音效作用域、音效选择）均在 **设置 → 反馈** 中配置，持久化在 localStorage 中。

dsh-task-feedback README · 其他说明：- **从 DSH v0.1.2-alpha.1 开始适配，已在 DSH v0.2.1-alpha.2 上验证**（主视图会话与待介入状态均为双代次兼容读取）
- **双模式适配** — 已在浏览器（Web）与 Desktop 客户端两种模式下验证；Favicon 相关的可视化仅在 Web 模式下可见
- **纯前端** — 无自定义协议、无 host 命令、无 LLM 调用、不进会话日志
- **稳定钩子** - 接入 DSH 的 sessions 与 uiSession 标准服务获取任务的运行状态、子代理活动和待介入事件
- **后续计划** - 支持用户上传自定义音效、支持系统级通知
- **注意事项** - 暂不支持 `/goal` 模式

dsh-task-feedback README · dsh-task-feedback：[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-task-feedback)
[](https://github.com/Pudge1996/dsh-task-feedback/blob/main/LICENSE)

[中文](README.md) | English

A session status feedback plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). Built from a real pain point:

> When you switch to another tab or step away from your computer, you have no way of knowing whether the agent has finished its response or needs your input.
dsh-task-feedback README · Install：```sh
dsh-task-feedback README · Browser-served Web profile：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-task-feedback

dsh-task-feedback README · Desktop app profile：dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-task-feedback
```

dsh-task-feedback README · Version matrix：The DSH client API is **not forward-compatible** across `rc.x` → `alpha.x`: a wrong pick does not degrade gracefully, it crashes at runtime (common symptom: `TypeError: useConversation is not a function`). Pick the plugin version that matches your DSH:

dsh-task-feedback README · Version matrix：| Your DSH | Install |
|---|---|
| `0.2.x` (verified on `v0.2.1-alpha.2`) | `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-task-feedback` (latest, currently `0.2.1`) |
| `0.1.2-alpha.1` – `0.1.x` | `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-task-feedback@0.1.0` |

dsh-task-feedback README · Version matrix：> The main-view session and pending-interaction reads are dual-generation compatible, so `0.2.x` usually runs on older DSH as well; only the `0.2.x` × `v0.2.1-alpha.2` pairing above has been verified for this release (`0.2.1` differs from `0.2.0` in metadata only — the runtime code is byte-identical).

dsh-task-feedback README · Favicon indicator：When you switch away from the tab, the DSH favicon turns into a coloured dot that reflects the current session state in real time: 1. **Green** — the current task has completed. 2. **Blue** — the current task is in progress or a subagent is running. 3. **Amber** — needs your input (approval, plan confirmation, answering a question, etc.). Design decisions:

dsh-task-feedback README · Favicon indicator：1. The favicon only changes when the tab is hidden (powered by the native [Page Visibility API](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Page_Visibility_API)).
2. If the session was already idle or completed, the favicon stays as the default whale (minimum distraction).
3. Configurable shapes: `Small dot` | `Circle` | `Rounded rectangle`.
4. **The shape setting is Web-only** — a Desktop shell window has no browser tab strip, so the favicon is never visible there and the "Favicon shape" group is hidden in Settings.
dsh-task-feedback README · Sound notifications： 12 hand-picked synthesised sounds. Choose different sounds for "task done" and "needs your input", and control when they play:

dsh-task-feedback README · Sound notifications：1. `Always` — play sound notifications regardless of tab visibility, whenever the session completes or needs your input.
2. `Only when unfocused` — only play while the page is away from you: the tab is hidden (switched away, minimised, display off — native [Page Visibility API](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Page_Visibility_API)) or the window lost focus because you switched to another application (the `window` `blur` event).

dsh-task-feedback README · Sound notifications：**Tech highlight** — all sounds are synthesised in real time via the [Web Audio API](https://github.com/m1ckc3s/procedural-sounds) with zero external dependencies. Hover over any sound option in the settings to preview it.

All settings (favicon shape, sound scope, sound selection) are configured in **Settings → Feedback** and persisted to localStorage.

dsh-task-feedback README · Notes：- **Tested from DSH v0.1.2-alpha.1, verified on DSH v0.2.1-alpha.2** (main-view session and pending-interaction reads stay generation-tolerant)
- **Dual-mode** — verified under both the browser (Web) profile and the Desktop client; everything favicon-related is only visible in Web mode.
- **Frontend only** — no custom protocols, no host commands, no LLM calls, no session-log entries.
- **Stable hooks** — reads session state, subagent activity, and pending interactions through DSH's standard `sessions` and `uiSession` services.
- **Roadmap** — custom sound uploads, system-level notifications.
- **Limitations** — `/goal` mode is not yet supported.
